_help: Font pairings for the Style tab: a verse font and a hook font (and optionally a title font), each with its weight (100-900: 400 = regular, 500 = medium, 600 = semibold, 700 = bold) and italic (true / false). The fonts must exist (pnpm fonts lists them; your own go in workspace\fonts). note: one line about the pair's character. warning: shown on its card. The "brand" pairing is not listed here: it is always the artist's own brand.json fonts. Edit freely; the Style tab names any font or weight that does not exist.

pairings.name: Elegant
pairings.note: One family, two voices: calm roman verses, a refined semibold italic for the hook.

pairings.name: Dramatic
pairings.note: Classic verses with a high-contrast Playfair italic hook: theatrical, cinematic.

pairings.name: Romantic script
pairings.note: A flowing wedding-invitation script for the hook.
pairings.warning: Great Vibes is a thin script: short hooks only, and set them large.

pairings.name: Literary
pairings.note: Book-page verses with a warm, retro brush hook.

pairings.name: Typewriter story
pairings.note: A slab serif told like a diary, the hook typed out in mono.

pairings.name: Vintage romance
pairings.note: Clean, friendly verses with a 1950s script hook.

pairings.name: Bold statement
pairings.note: Modern geometric verses, a heavy fat-face hook that shouts.

pairings.name: Gentle
pairings.note: Soft, rounded verses with a light, airy hook.
